subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should maintainers close or supersede this protected macOS onboarding branch in favor of current main plus https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/102642, or ask for a narrow rebase that preserves a specific remaining UX change?
rationale: The `maintainer` label blocks automatic cleanup, and the branch mixes superseded setup work with security/auth compatibility blockers that require maintainer ownership to either retire or reshape.

options.title: Confirm supersession
options.body: Close or supersede this PR after a maintainer confirms current main plus the linked issue owns the remaining macOS onboarding work.

options.title: Request a narrow rebase
options.body: Ask the contributor to rebase on current main, keep only the unique UX improvement maintainers still want, and fix the security/auth/proof blockers before review continues.

options.title: Adopt manually
options.body: A maintainer can adopt the branch or cherry-pick selected pieces, but the current PR should not merge as-is.

recommendation.title: Confirm supersession
recommendation.body: Close or supersede this PR after a maintainer confirms current main plus the linked issue owns the remaining macOS onboarding work.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the merged current-main macOS setup changes that supersede most of this branch and is the best available owner for the close-or-rebase choice.
